summary_en: A browser Snake game: each tick code lists the legal moves and tells Jev-Style v3 only whether each one gets closer to the food; code alone filters deadly moves and counts free space. Compare against a greedy code bot on the same seeds.
summary_zh: 浏览器里的贪吃蛇：每一步由代码列出可走方向，只告诉 Jev-Style v3 每个方向是靠近还是远离食物；致命方向和剩余空间只由代码处理。可在相同种子上与贪心代码对比。
